cases.name: the clamp offers the floor itself, the first port inside the range
caught_by: the highest port it can offer is one below the floor

cases.name: the floor is assumed rather than read
cases.new: return ASSUMED if handle else ASSUMED
caught_by: a readable range gives its own floor, not the fallback

cases.name: a garbled range is no longer caught
caught_by: a range that is not a number falls back to the assumed floor

cases.name: distinctness is dropped, so a caller can get the same port twice
caught_by: a repeated draw is not offered twice

cases.name: the bottom of the range moves up, past what LOW promises
caught_by: the highest port it can offer is one below the floor
